title: Whoosh went the box
text:
This is a box containing a palette of 15 eye shadow colors, from a mustardy yellow (“ginger”), to a deep brown (“volcano”). Ingredients include: mica, magnesium stearate, dimethicone, bismuth oxychloride, capryly methicone, methylpaben, pro pylparaben, CI 77891, CI 77492, CI 77499, CI 77891. Each patch contains enough eye shadow for several applications, depending on how thick you like to go. Instructions say to apply with a brush or fingertip; no brush is included. The box has a magnetic closure, with a plastic sheet of transparent vinyl inside and comes in a cardboard sleeve. The product was made in China.

I have found this kit fun to experiment with. The colors are vibrant with a variety of earthy tones as well as some reds (“rose”). I tried using my own brush (no brush is supplied), but found I had better luck with my fingertips. The product stays put nicely without flaking and I haven’t noticed any skin reactions when I used it. I particularly like the darker brown colors like “bronze” or “ash”. For special occasions, some of the orangey/reds also look good like “pumpkin”. My biggest issue with this set is that when I first opened the box, it was cold and dry in my house, and as the magnets snapped open, some of the eye shadow patches spurted out of their pockets—I had “mermaid” spreading everywhere within the box. A brush would have been nice to include, but that probably would have raised the price, especially for a quality brush. Overall, this is a versatile eye shadow kit with attractive colors, but it doesn’t travel well. Best to use at home!

title: Messy But Fun
text:
This is a fun set to have around for parties or kids crafting. The way it works is you place a stencil on your skin, brush on body glue with the brush attached to the glue bottle (much like nail polish), sprinkle some of the glitter on and brush off the excess with a soft make up brush (brush not included, but you can get one from the dollar store). Make sure the glue is thin, or the glitter gets clumpy, and brush the glitter off onto a piece of paper so you can dump the glitter back into the container. The kit comes with 2 bottles of "star glue", 36 glitter colors in a handy plastic case, 135 tattoo stencils, 2 pages of rhinestones and 4 pages of temporary tattoos.

Now the temporary tattoos will last up to seven days depending on where you put them. They fade much easier on your hand since there is a lot of hand washing usually going on in seven days. The glitter tattoo is only going to last as long as no moisture gets on the skin. It's basically gel glue, so it's not waterproof. You can expand the kit by buying regular stencils from a hobby shop like Hobby Lobby. You can also refill the kit by buying body glue off Amazon or gel glue (cheaper) wherever you buy glue, and buying fine glitter off Amazon or the dollar store. BTW, it's glitter, so expect a bit of a mess, but the results are worth it.

This comb has a medium brown finish with greenish streaks in the wood. It is very attractive in appearance. It is 3 and 13/16 inches long from end to end, 2 and 5/16 inches wide and approximately 3/8 inches thick at the center of the handle which tapers to pointed teeth on each side.

The comb is sturdy and feels good in the hand. Both sides taper to a nice smooth finish with a well-rounded, but not sharp point. “HAWATOUR” is etched into the wood. This comb weighs 1.1 ounces on the food scale.

Experience using the product
My daily routine is to massage a quality beard balm followed by quality beard oil into the beard and skin. I then brush my beard with a boar bristle brush and comb my beard for a couple of minutes. I comb periodically through the day and generally do the Balm/oil massage in the morning and again after a bath or shower in the evening. All pimples, chaffing, beardruff, itching and irritation have gone away since performing this routine.

This comb gives a therapeutic feeling and the teeth do not scrape the skin like plastic combs do. I purchased this comb for my son who also wears a thick beard. He does not and probably will not carry this comb in his pocket for risk of losing or breaking it.

I stated in the video that instructions were included but I was mistaken. The sheet is on how to leave a review. I guess you don’t really need instructions with a comb. Durp! If you are interested in a thicker tooth spacing on one side and thinner tooth spacing on the other also check out Dream Bear’s comb.

Why the rating?
This is a high quality grooming piece which feels great on the beard and skin, and is a pleasure to use. This comb is easily a 5 star product. Overall, I am happy with the purchase. This product was received, and tested during a promotional period at a discount. I have attempted to give a thorough, comprehensive, objective, and honest review; I hope it has been helpful to you.

title: Great for putting moisture back into your hair.
text:
Like a previous reviewer, I also received steamer in a box labeled "O'Hair Steamer," but that didn't bother me because all 3 of the models I researched appear to have the exact same design. There must not be an active patent for this device. It was delivered via USPS and arrived in perfect condition. The instructions read like they were translated from another language. I didn't bother with the diagramed instruction booklet, I found a YouTube video from one of my favorite natural hair vloggers, Nikkimae. She provided step by step video instructions on to assemble a steamer that looks exactly like this model. Make sure you have the tube that connects the bonnet to the base connected, as well a as the tiny plug that is located at the base of the bonnet, or you might get leaks. It took less them five minutes to assemble. It took about 3 minutes to start producing loads of stream.
Because the stem that connects the bonnet to the base is not adjustable, you can't adjust the height of the bonnet. Fortunately, the counter I placed mine on and the chair in which I sat provided the perfect height to allow my head to fit under the bonnet so the steam came in contact with all of my hair. I still had to wear a narrow elastic headband so the back of my hair could come in contact with the steam.
I used my favorite deep conditioner and after 20 minutes under the steamer, my hair felt soft and was much easier to comb and style. I like the results much better than using a heat cap for deep conditioning.
The unit doesn't fold down for storage like a bonnet style hair dryer, but fortunately, I have the space to store it fully assembled.
So far, I am very pleased with this. The jury is still out regarding durability, so my opinion may change over time.

The seller told me to sew in some clips to secure them better, but....the whole reason I chose the halo style is to avoid the damage to my hair from the clips, so that would defeat the purpose here for me. I'm shopping for another brand to see if I can find some that have a more forgiving adjustment and perhaps less of the lace backing on the weft, which may enable it to sit more securely against the head.

title: LOVE LOVE LOVE
text:
After reading all the reviews on this, I decided to give it a try as a cheaper alternative to Latisse. I have to admit, I was quite skeptical. It is really only a glorified conditioner, with no drugs in it like the prescription Latisse or even the expensive Lashes To Die For. My lashes had gotten so sparse and short over the years, even having minor bald spots in some areas. I would use the most revved-up mascaras I could find, only to have my lashes barely noticible, even after many coats! This is super easy to apply; just use it consistantly at bedtime for at least 4 weeks and you will be amazed. I now have people comment on my lashes- most say they thought I was wearing false eyelashes! (I do still wear mascara,as my lashes are on the lighter side, but it is only 1 coat.)
There are a few key things to remember when using this product:
-You must use it every night in the beginning to see the best results. It takes only seconds to do.
-The results are much more apparent if you use an eyelash curler and/or mascara.
-The tube lasts much longer than it says. I'm on my second now, and the first lasted 4 months using it every day. (Long enough to see if it works on you).
-Most importantly- give it at least 4 weeks to see the results! Be patient!
Give this one a try- you will be amazed!

title: Definitely not the results I was hoping for…
text:
I ordered this night cream as a form of TLC for my sometimes combination skin and although I was hoping to incorporate it into my routine (especially during the winter months when the temperature drops and tends to wreak havoc on my finicky skin.) I’m afraid that this one was a huge miss for me.

While I did enjoy the overall creaminess of this particular night cream and I definitely appreciated the fact that I didn’t have to use a lot to achieve maximum coverage, (a pea-sized amount on my fingertip did the trick.) I found the smell of this product to be a little heavier and lingering than you might expect of a product meant to be used before bed, but that I could bypass… what I couldn’t however, was that next day feeling.

Instead of waking up and feeling as if my skin were properly hydrated and moisturized, I found that the overall texture had become noticeably dryer than before I began to incorporate this product into my nighttime routine and that throughout several weeks I found myself having to apply creams and lotions throughout the day to help get my skin’s texture back to its natural state, which is why I can only give this one star.

⭐️

While it’s true that everyone experiences different results, if your skin tends to dry out easily, I’d recommend using extreme care when trying out this particular brand of night cream.

To preface, I bought this product for when my hands or feet randomly get dry, and it seems I'll have to keep searching for a better product. Ultimately, I discarded this product. TIP: The best way to know if a product is good for your skin is to use it on your hands, feet, and/or face, since those are the most sensitive and picky areas (skin-wise) of the body. It dried out my hands and feet quickly after use, so I knew it would have the same effect on the rest of my body even if the effect is not as noticeable in other areas.

I tried to use this product when my hands or feet got dry. I like being in cold environments, so I often have lotion or something on standby for when my hands or feet inevitably get dry. Whenever I used this, my hands became dry again after about 30 minutes, when I expect it to last at least an hour like other products I've tried. So I decided this moisturizer is not for me and I ended up throwing this away.

title: Great mirror. One small design flaw.
text: I love this mirror. I have used it for nearly three years and have been happy with it. When I first purchased it, i was planning to use the battery feature as i didn’t want another appliance that needed to be plugged in on my bathroom counter. But that battery feature is weak, the batteries run low quickly and the light is not as bright on battery power. Totally worth plugging it in for the brightness. The design flaw is in the rotation from magnified to unmagnified. You can rotate the mirror any direction and number of times you want. So, unless you are disciplined enough to only rotate the mirror 90 degrees one way and then back the opposite direction, you are effectively twisting the wires. We all know that if you twist wires enough they become faulty. Had the design included a stop on the rotation so that you could only rotate it one way and then back the other, it would reduce the chances of the wires twisting too much. Over the years I am sure I have twisted them a few too many times now so the light will sometimes flicker or become dim because those wires are weak and losing connection. One simple mechanism could have improved the longevity of this mirror.

title: Amazing Foot Peel Mask
text:
I have been wanting to try one of these foot peels for some time now. I was so excited to get started with this. The box comes with 2 packages inside. In each package, is 2 booties.
This was so easy to do and the directions were simple to figure out. The only part that I did not understand was how you are supposed to secure/close the booties once you put them on your feet. It said something like, press the red tab. But there was no red tab anywhere. But.. I figured out an even better way to do it.
Open one package by just tearing across the top. Inside is 2 booties. You will see a red line going across... Cut that with the scissors. Make sure your feet are clean and dry before doing this.
Slip one foot into each bootie. Then what I did was I got a pair of socks, and I put them over the booties. It was a lot easier and it held the booties in place perfect.
I did one set then waited 48 hours and I used the second set. I kept the second one on for a lot longer than an hour.
After I took them off... WOW!! I could not believe how great it was working. My feet started to peel off.. It was really awesome. It was just peeling off in a very thin layer. Huge pieces. I did not get all of it off at first. So I let my feet rest for a bit, then soaked my feet in warm water, and I continued to peel the rest of my feet apart. I never knew that peeling dry skin off of my feet, could be so entertaining and fun.
I am almost done getting all the dry skin off. But I can not believe how smooth and how soft my feet are turning out.
This foot mask, really does work, and it works perfect.
I will upload a video and maybe some pictures to show you the before and after.
This Foot mask is so worth the money. IT works 100% as it says that it will work.
Simple to use. And you will be extremely happy with the results!!

title: Captivating But Concerning
text:
Amore Pacific, based in South Korea, lists "alcohol" as an ingredient in its Color Control Cushion Compact with SPF 50. Since there are good and bad alcohols, I resisted jumping to a negative conclusion especially because I agree with AP regarding the impressive visible benefits conferred by their treatment foundation that has many fans atwitter and aglow.

AP's response to my inquiry was delayed, which I considered either bad (corporate communications) netiquette or bad news. After four workdays, I received a reply thanking me for my "patience" as a response from R&D "to ensure correct information and advice" had not yet been received. When I informed the company that I HAVE no patience and am spoiled by live chats, which provide instant gratification, I received an answer two days later. Apparently, bamboo sap, the primary moisturizing ingredient, is easily contaminated as it's stored for prolonged periods. To prevent "micro-organic pollution," anhydrous alcohol is used. This is ethyl alcohol, which some scientists who write for respected journals warn consumers to avoid because it penetrates the skin barrier and provokes short- and long-term harm, exacerbates oily skin and redness, and may even minimize the efficacy of good ingredients including those that protect against sun damage.

AP is the parent company of Sulwhasoo, which makes a Perfecting Cushion that also includes "alcohol" but not bamboo sap. I don't know what ingredient(s) this brand is protecting.

AP asserts that their anhydrous alcohol is dermatologist approved, but we have no idea who the dermatologist is and whether or not the doctor was paid. AP says that their anhydrous alcohol is patented, but this is just ethyl alcohol with water removed and can't be patented.

The respected Washington, D.C.-based Environmental Working Group (EWG) rates this alcohol a 2 (out of 10) and asserts that anything between 1 and 2 is "low hazard." The overall EWG rating for AP's Color Control Cushion Compact is "4," meaning that it is of *moderate* concern to human health. (The nonprofit group objects most strenuously to the sunscreen octinoxate and to the fragrances included.)

Our U.S. FDA approves the use of ethyl alcohol.

In 2008, the National Institutes of Health urged further investigation, but rigorous double-blind, peer-reviewed studies demand a lot of time and money. Meanwhile, concern lingers.

title: They recommend to use it in the morning on DRY skin
text:
I bought this serum from ScienceSerum directly and returned it after 3 weeks of use since it dried out my around eye area beyond repair. Skin in the corners of my eyes started to crape, lines and wrinkles became more deep and pronounced because of the dryness, puffiness and dark circles appeared. It has been 4 weeks since I stopped using it, but I still have been able neither to quench the dryness nor diminish puffiness no matter what I do. I went to my derm, he said I have severe allergic reaction and prescribed steroids to combat the symptoms.

At the time when skin care layering is paramount, this product is a huge logistical failure.
It is very difficult to incorporate the serum into either- morning or night - routine. They recommend to use it in the morning on DRY skin, which means you would need to cleanse your face, wait for it to dry, apply it, then wait again for the serum to dry. Who has time for that much waiting in the morning? Another issue for me was that I could not leave my skin dry for that much time without applying toner and Vit C. But then, when the serum was dried, vitamin C would be washed off along with the serum. I wrote to the company and asked them how to properly layer it with other skincare products I use (Vitamin C, Retin-A, essences etc) they had no idea!
Another problem - it is extremely difficult to get it off your skin completely without pulling and tagging your delicate eye area. But if you do not pulling and tagging, the product stays on your skin and destroys it very rapidly.
If you have a question and write to Scienceserum, be prepared to contact them at least three times before they respond.
If you are going to buy directly from them and decide to return the serum, you will be responsible for return shipping AND they are going to withhold 20% of the serum cost for the original shipping. Returns are processed only on Mondays, so do not expect the return money to be on your account soon. The last drop was when I wrote to them about my experience, I received back one line reply consisting of the return address". No word of apology or concern.
Overall, it is a dangerous, damaging product, please be very cautious before buying it.

They don't really have a taste, but they smell amazing. They're clear to white in color and don't deposit any color or stain on my lips.

Reputable brand and skin protection! I can keep one in the house, one in the car, one in my purse, one in the medicine kit, and then extras for when I run out or lose one!

title: Leather Hair Slide (or Hair Pencil,  Hair Pin, Hair Pencil Pin)
text:
I have THICK hair that goes nearly down to my waist. So it can be pretty darn heavy. I got the Hair Slide yesterday. As soon as I got it, I took down my elastic tied ponytail and replaced it with the slide. It lasted the rest of the night.

The way I have always done it was the taken a top section of hair and cinched it in the back; in this case with the slide. I gather the hair as if I was going to use the elastic BUT I make sure that when I am placing the stick through, that I get a little of the hair that is under the section I just grabbed. For me, this secures it. Also sometimes I WILL use elastic and add the slide for decoration. Both methods have worked with all previous slides I have owned.

I am about to wear this particular slide for a full day of work and play. I will edit this review if it fails.

Edit: Some Hair Slides are NOT meant to hold lots of hair; I ended the day with all of my hair cinched in the back with this thing and it held pretty well (I changed the style because I needed all my hair out of the way with what I was doing). I still say it is a good hair slide for me.

title: Love this USDA certified Castor oil!
text:
If your use to the super tall 16oz plastic bottles of castor oil for a dirt cheap price, probably cheaper than this 4oz bottle, then your probably not understanding what is so great about castor oil. You more or less probably just use the castor oil as a cheap carrier oil to dilute essential oils, which I myself also do with those big cheap 16oz bottles. If your looking at this bottle and then the price and thinking no way, then I can guarantee you've never tried Pure, "real" ,no filler, Castor oil, because if you did, you would understand why this 4oz bottle costs what it does. Also you would have reaped the benefits in probably more ways than one from using True Castor oil , and would think this is actually a really great price for USDA organic certified castor oil. I use this oil as part of my night time facial regime, and it's also amazing at getting rid of scars and stretch marks.
This oil can also be used to help grow fuller darker lashes, eyebrows and you can even add it to your shampoo and or conditioner to improve the overall health and growth of your hair. The only Castor oil that I will put in my hair and on my face is USDA certified, otherwise you have no reassurance that what your using, especially on your face, is in fact pure and without fillers. Because of this not being a food item, the regulations on it are extremely light, and therefore companies can mix castor oil with water or other things and slap a pure castor oil label on it, and not have to disclose that it's been diluted in one way or any other. The ONLY way to know for sure is to purchase a bottle that's been stamped with the USDA stamp, which she means it has gone thru rigorous testing and is in fact pure with nothing added to it in anyway.
Pure castor oil is going to be semi thick, exactly like this oil from RejuveNaturals. This is great oil and I'm very satisfied with the purchase and recommend if you haven't tried pure USDA certified castor oil that you purchase a bottle of this castor oil from RejuveNaturals, it will change the way you look at castor oil forever. I did recieve a discount on this bottle during a promotional period. In return I agreed to give my honest unbiased opinion of the oil after having been able to test it. title: Works Well on Dry, Cracked Heels
text:
I have for years dealt with dry, cracked heels, and I have tried a number of things to correct the issue. While my heels haven’t hurt or anything, they have been ugly. In a search for solutions, I found this foot scrubber and decided it was likely going to work better for me than a foot rasp, and I ordered it. It’s a great tool and it works well, though I do offer some caution for those who haven’t worked with a foot scrubber or rasp in the past.

This is an odd-looking instrument, vaguely similar to a comma in shape. The scraping side somewhat resembles a mirror with a patterned rough edge. It feels a lot like an emery board though it has more of a “bite” to the surface, if that makes sense. The overall size and shape make it easy to grip and hold, even when wet.

The first time I used it, I scraped away a fairly large amount of dead skin, to the point that I had feeling in parts of my heels where I have had no feeling for quite some time. It left my heels soft, pink and looking much better. However, I did discover that one can overdo, and I had nicked myself on each heel in one or two places, just enough to require blotting but not enough to really be a concern (it was less serious than a cut while shaving).

I discovered the following day what happens when you remove too much dead skin and don’t put enough lotion on an area that deals with weight and stress – my heels split in a couple of places and I ended up having difficulty walking without pain for a couple of days. I had put high-quality lotion on my heels, but apparently not enough. That was entirely my mistake, and it was a painful one.

After that finally healed up, I tried again. I have fallen into a daily routine where I gently scrub my heels for a couple of minutes each, then apply lotion. My heels now look much better, they’re not splitting when I put weight on them, and I have avoided nicking myself. At least in my case this is not a tool that gets used intensely every couple of weeks, but rather it is a daily tool that gets used very gently.

I got curious and put this tool under a digital microscope to see what the rough surface looked like. The roughness resembles a series of crescents, not dissimilar to a rasp, but much more fine.

This thing really works and it does a good job. It’s slightly more expensive than the average foot rasp but it seems to work well. I do recommend using some caution when working with this instrument as it is possible to overdo if not careful, which is probably very true of any tool of this type.

text:
This is a good straightener. I have very curly hair. Getting that hair tamed is quite an undertaking. I loved the idea of having a brush and straightener in one. The hard plastic exterior is very durable.

My hair resembles a puff ball in it's natural state without any products in it. So, straightening my viciously curly hair is quite an undertaking. This straightener did get my hair straight. Although, it was a puffy straight. After I applied a product, The puffiness went away. A normal flat straightener is able to achieve a non puffy straight without the need for products.

I will say that this worked perfectly for my daughter who has moderately curly hair. This brush hair straightener gave her a flat straight look with only one or two swipes. By these findings, I would say this is ideal for people with moderate or less curly hair.

Using this straightener is extremely simple. The LED light up screen makes the screen easy to see the temperature and other controls. The buttons easily press on the handle. This straightener also headed up to the full temperature in 1 or 2 minutes. After I unplugged it, it took around 5 minutes for it to completely cool down.

The quality of this straightener is exceptional. The hard plastic material is extremely durable and does stand up against my vigorous daily use. The brush itself is very strong. Even while attempting to get it through my puff ball of hair, the brush did not bend or break. The cord is also a long cord that is very thick. All of the connections between each of the pieces is quite substantial. I did not feel any movement between any of them.

Overall, I would recommend this hair straightener if you have moderate or less curly hair. The quality of the construction and design is exceptional. I rate this 5/5 stars. I did receive this at a discounted or free rate for my honest and unbiased opinion, but all opinions expressed are my own.

title: Frozen = NC10-15
text:
I've gone through a dozen concealers trying to find one that both matched my pale warm olive skin tone and covered my extremely dark circles. This concealer beats out all the rest, even the $60 concealer I tried out of desperation.
I purchased the lightest shade, Frozen, and it matches me extremely well. For reference, I'm about NC10-15. I wear Armani Luminous Silk foundation in shade 3 when I've got a little color or Nars Sheer Glow in Siberia in the winter. This would probably also work well for one shade darker in the Nars Sheer Glow (Gobi I think it's called?).
Frozen is not an olive tone; it's straight-up warm/yellow-based. However, since I use it to cover rosacea and purple/brown under-eye circles, the extra yellow doesn't clash with my complexion.
The texture is a thick cream---thicker than Nars Radiant Creamy Concealer, sort of like Tarte Shape Tape, but not nearly as chalky or quick-drying. It has a very natural luminosity and you have lots of time to work with it before it sets. You can achieve full coverage with just a small amount of product, and it builds well without getting cakey. I live in a swampy climate and it doesn't smudge, crease, or flake all day long.

title: A non-toxic lipstick that doesn't leave you wanting for your old brand
text:
I'm in the process of replacing my makeup with brands that use safer ingredients and am thrilled with this find! To my dismay, I've wasted a fair amount of money trying out more "natural" products with poor results. Pacifica's Devocean Lipsticks are not only natural, but excellent products!

Pros:
- Does not contain iffy chemicals like most lipsticks, and has an EWG rating of 2
- Inexpensive; Half the cost of most non-toxic lipsticks
- Doesn't stain lips or surrounding skin;This is a huge perk for me. When I apply lipstick, I often get a bit of it outside of my lip line on the first few swipes. Many lipsticks I've used have left a color residue on my surrounding skin, even after I've wiped the product away. This lipstick doesn't!
- Smooth consistency; Not too slick or too dry. I would say it applies even better after a thin base layer of moisturizing lip balm, but this isn't necessary.
- Color can be built up and looks great at any "level"

title: I highly recommend this product if you have curly, dry, brittle, dull and frizzy hair
text:
I didn't buy this treatment from Amazon, but I thought I'd review it since when I browsed it before buying the product I wished it had a good review.

This keratin treatment did truly what it said it would, my frizz has been 99% tamed and my hair looks and feels soft. It's silky, smooth and shiny. The down side was that my hair was weighed down after washing the treatment. I hope this will go away in the next wash cycle or so. I followed the instructions provided, if your hair is resistant or virgin to keratin I recommend shampooing with the Anti-residue Shampoo (Step 1) twice making it work in your hair for 5 minutes each time. You can then let your hair air dry or blow dry it with either cool/warm/heat setting up to 85-90% (I used a cool setting here). Then apply the treatment (Step 2) with a fine comb after sectioning your hair, make sure not to get it too close to the scalp unless you're combing it upwards fast. The key thing here is to not let the solution drip down to your scalp or skin otherwise it will burn and cause irritation. A bit of an advice here, if you have vaseline I'd recommend applying it to the skin area that's close to hair line avoiding touching any of your hair (of course this is optional). Try not to over saturate, once all your hair has been coated well with the treatment without over saturating use the cool/warm but NOT the heat setting in your blow dryer to fully dry the product before using the flat iron. You can use your fingers to help with the drying and not a brush/comb. The ironing step is crucial here, you want to make sure that every strand is straight and coated with the heat from the iron 8-10 times. This ensures a straight hair after washing the treatment, so move the flat iron on each section 8-10 times on a perpendicular angle from the scalp. Once it's all straight, you can go ahead and wash your hair with warm water ensuring to scrub your scalp with your fingertips to get rid of all the solution out of your hair, then towel dry (no water dripping) before applying the "Repair Mask" (Step 3). With the last step, apply the mask generously all over then massaging it to your scalp and ensure the ends are covered too. You can wrap a plastic/shower bag and warm dry towel (I warmed my towel in the dryer first) and leave it on for at least 30 minutes or longer (I left mine close to an hour). You can comb the mask to make sure every strand is well covered.

In case you were wondering, you don't have to keep your hair straight when you apply Step 2 (Keratin Treatment), in fact once you've done a section you can swirl it back and clip it. For me, when I coated all my hair I took the clips out and combed my hair again before blow drying. Then after washing the mask thoroughly I left my hair to air dry, but you can use a heat setting here if you want to.

And the fresh smell, which I expected not to like at all because any eucalyptus smell reminds me of cough drops, was actually one of my favorites. It reminded me of men that shower daily, shave regularly, comb their hair, and possibly go to the barber, and get all the ladies. This is what clean men should smell like.

So there you go, the do-it-all beard oil 3 pack. Take care of the hair on your face and smell like a man.

title: A beauty industry expert's professional opinion
text:
Not all Obagi products are made at the same place -- but i found out that this formula is made by one of the top skincare labs in the US--one that manufactures high-end dermatologist and clinical skincare brands on the market today. So knowing this, i knew there would be *some* efficacy to this product. I actually LIKE that ingredients are straightforward and not full of fluff:

Water (Aqua), Dipropylene Glycol, Ethoxydiglycol, Caffeine, Malonic Acid, Zinc Carbonate, Arginine, Laureth-9, Copper Carbonate Hydroxide, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Sodium Hydroxide, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin

To be honest--if you're looking to reduce eye puffiness and dark circles, this won't do much. If found no visible evidence of that in my use. BUT--it's really good at minimizing fine lines, plumping up the skin, and returning elasticity to the skin. That's why it's called "Elasti-derm", to help coax the skin into being more hydrated, refined, and pliant, thus reducing the signs of lines. Obagi's main active to do that is malonic acid, and I give a big thumbs up to the addition of arginine-- a powerful delivery vehicle to help drive the malonic acid further into the skin for more efficacy. As many in the skincare industry know, anything with arginine helps make the active ingredient even more "active".

The stainless steel ball is not just a "feel good" gimmick -- it actually helps to massage this serum into the delicate eye skin, further pushing the ingredients into the dermis. After using an entire bottle of this product, i definitely experienced a reduction in the signs of my fine lines. the skin was plumped up and the lines less visible, plus the texture more refined. Used in conjunction with a good eye cream and alternating with Vitamin C serum, this is a great addition to any anti-aging regimen. I would surely purchase again.

I take off one star because I do not like the plastic packaging, as glass is the safest material for stability, and plastic has a tendency to shorten the shelf life of a formula. Plus plastics are not as safe we think.

title: Much easier than glue
text:
This was my first attempt at using magnetic lashes; there's a small learning curve but oh my gosh - SO MUCH EASIER than the old eyelash glue that comes in a separate tube! They're very comfortable; like any false lashes they feel weird at first but after about 15 minutes I forgot they were there & wore them all day with no issues. They stay where you put them, they DO NOT budge until you pull them off. No glue melting or flaking off into my eyes, obviously that's a big benefit! They look super dramatic with pretty minimal effort.

I'm a little confused as to why it's best to apply the lashes when the eyeliner is half-dry but still tacky; is there glue built in to the liner as well as magnets? If you need to reposition them, you have to reapply the eyeliner because the lashes pull some of it off. The eyeliner is very wet when you apply, so be careful - you have to shake the tube before application, and when I pulled the brush out, it spewed eyeliner onto the wall (and it was not super easy to remove). So that's the learning curve part, now that I know I'll avoid those pitfalls.

The one unavoidable pitfall is that it is INCREDIBLY difficult to remove. I used 3 different types of makeup remover & still needed to scrub my eyelids for a good 10 minutes to get all of it. Not great for the eyelid wrinkle situation! I slathered on a lot of pampering eye cream afterward because my lids were a little sore. I guess I'm glad it won't wear off halfway through the day, but geez!

Anyway, despite the difficulty removing it, I'm pretty smitten. I used to love wearing false lashes but they were just so much trouble that I gave it up a few years ago. Now I love them again & they're easy!! I want to order all the lashes!

text:
I have been using Norelco cordless electric shavers for about 20 years now. Fortunately, years ago it did not take long for my face to adjust.

Recently had to replace a 7 year old Norelco shaver when the internal battery charging circuitry fizzled. Because I frequently shave far away from an a/c outlet, I needed the timer display to tell me to get ready for a charge. This feature is a must and helped make my decision easy, on which new model to buy.

Only way to get my feature was to go for the top-of-the-line 9190 XL Norelco model and make the 200 smacker investment. Thus far it has lived up to my expectations. Shaves about 40 percent quicker than the older versions and is extremely quiet !

On the dark side, I have also found a couple of minor shortcomings: First, the travel-carrying case is difficult to unlatch. The only time it opened easily is when it fell on the floor ! This unit should not have popped open at all. Second, although the timer display is large, certain numbers are not so easy to read. A number 8 looks a lot like a 3.

All things considered, it has been a worthwhile purchase for me and should provide years of reliable service. This one you will enjoy !

title: Not Great for Thick/Wavy Hair. Pretty & OK for Touch-Ups
text:
My whole life I've needed to use a hair straightener. I have very thick strands of hair and a lot of it. Plus, my hair is poofy crazy curly. My hair used to be down to my butt, however, this past year I had to cut it all off due to getting a horrid matted mess. (If you don't know what it means to have matted hair - your lucky). It was a whole bunch of tears, pain, tantrums, home remedies, a ton of hair salon visits and a ton of money spent until realizing that I was s*** outta luck and had to cry as they cut my hair to only an inch in the back, but luckily had enough hair left / saved on top and on sides for shoulder length hair. So now more than ever, having short hair that's very thick and curly, I'm always looking for amazing hair straighteners and products in general.

I have wanted one of these heat and style brushes and finally decided to test this one out. I loved the color of this heat brush and it looked like a nice, high quality hair straightening brush in the images.

This brush has less options then I thought it would. I cannot control the temperature and I would like for it to get a little bit hotter. Since I have curly, wavy hair this doesn't heat up enough to get it straight. Or maybe it's not doing a great job because it doesn't have two "plates" like regular straighteners. If I straighten my hair with a flat iron, this is a great touch up tool for the days following the flat iron before I wash my hair again. SO - It does work, but it is NOT a miracle product. This hair straightening brush (& all brush type of straighteners) MIGHT work better / work faster / have better results if you have thin hair? Just a assumption.

One difference I noticed was the way my hair felt after styling with the Envy brush. When I use my flat iron, my hair is...flat. The flat iron leaves my hair very smooth but it doesn't seem to have much texture or body left after straightening. When I used the Envy brush, my hair was straight, but still had plenty of volume. I'm really happy I bought the Envy styling brush. I really like the volume my hair has after using this brush.

I had to completely comb through my hair to smooth it out before using this brush (obviously). I started out by just running the Envy brush through my hair. Once I was done brushing my hair, I sectioned off my hair for the best results. I sectioned off the top 2/3 of my hair, twisted and secured it to the top of my head. As always, I focused on the underside first. When I finished the under layer, I moved on to the middle section, and then the top. The whole process took me about 20minutes. Pretty close to the same amount of time that it takes me to use my regular flat iron.

An ion is as an atom in which the number of electrons and protons are not the same. When a hair tool has ionic in its name, it means that it can generate negative ions. Hair has high water content, making it positively charged. When negative ions come in contact with hair, the positive charge is neutralized. This leaves your hair straight, sleek, shiny and smooth.

Here is one crucial thing to keep in mind – not all flat irons are pure ceramic, many of them are aluminum. They are just coated with ceramic on the top. Such models are less expensive, but you need to be extra careful when using them. This coating can chip or peel, revealing less quality metal below. These peeled areas can snag your hair! So always try to find out if an iron is coated or not.
You can even find costly professional models that are not 100% ceramic. Solid or pure ceramic are words that you are looking for.

I'm not sure if this brush is ceramic, titanium or what..?!?

Titanium vs. Ceramic
In this battle, it is obvious that titanium is a winner. But does this mean that you should use only this type of iron? No. Many experts say that consumers should use ceramic for one obvious reason. Since titanium can get very hot and transfers heat better, it’s very easy to damage your hair if you are not careful. Also, this high heat is only advantageous for women with thick, coarse and stubborn hair. If your have thin or fragile hair, there is no need for high temperatures. In the end, it is up to you to find out what will work best for your hair. Now you have all the facts to make the right decision. If you are still indecisive, there is a simple solution! Get a flat iron that combines ceramic and titanium, such as Croc 2 Infrared mentioned above. This way you get ceramic’s safety and protection and titanium’s speed and efficiency.

title: A mix of good and bad
text:
A couple weeks ago, I started going to a new stylist. I was telling her about my struggles to find a good shampoo. My roots are greasy, but the rest is pretty dry. I have tried so many sulfate free shampoos. But I’ve found they either don’t clean well or they strip and dry my hair. I was recommended this shampoo and conditioner. I don’t usually use conditioner because it is a major pain to rinse out and tends to weigh down my hair. I have fine hair and a lot of it. The stylist suggested that I only use a dime sized amount and rub it between my hands to emulsify it. You only need a tiny amount of the conditioner too. At first, I really liked both, but now I have very mixed feelings. I also have very allergy prone skin.

The Good
Only need a very small amount
Easy to rinse out
A light, clean smell

The Bad
At first, I liked this shampoo and conditioner a lot. But the longer I use it, the less I like it. My scalp is really itchy, and I feel like my hair doesn’t get very clean. It still seems greasy even after washing it twice. It also seems to be stripping and drying out my hair. It just doesn’t look very nice. It also seems a lot more frizzy. I haven’t decided if I’m going to finish the bottles or just toss them. When I go back, maybe I will try Alluram instead. So disappointed.

title: TARTE IS THE VERY BEST
text:
I have used "Tarte Shape Tape Hydrating Foundation" since it first came out and have loved it. Tarte has done away with the 'Shape Tape Foundation' and has replaced it with..... "Face Tape Foundation."

I tried the "Face Tape Foundation" which is somehow a blend of the 'matte' and the 'hydrating' Shape Tape Foundation formulas. It didn't do well for me. It did not seem to cover as well, and it didn't give my skin that airbrushed glow and look. It was ok, but wasn't superior to other foundations on the market like the Shape Tape Hydrating Foundation was.

I am a Baby Boomer and have dry skin that has lines and some wrinkles. The Hydrating Foundation really made my complexion look very good. It has become more and more difficult to find my shade in the Hydrating Formula which is 29B. Now that I can no longer find it, I decided to try the Shape Tape Matte Formula in shade 29B.

I see from other reviews that the Matte Formula can be very drying, settling into pores, wrinkles and lines. When I wore it, it felt like it literally sucked the moisture right out if my facial skin, leaving it almost painfully dry!!!

I have discovered a way to sidestep that and make this look and feel just as nice as the Hydrating Formula. Under my moisturizer, I apply a thin layer of Argan Oil. Then after a couple of minutes I apply my moisturizer. Then I apply "Tarte Base Tape PRIMER." This primer is amazing and seriously the best I've ever used. It is amazing how it makes the Matte Formula look and feel as nice as the Hydrating Formula. It leaves your skin feeling so supple and moist, but not oily.

I'm thrilled I can still find the Tarte Shape Tape Foundation in my shade, even in the Matte Formula. With the benefit of argan oil and the superior Tarte Base Tape Primer, the problem has been resolved.

I will buy a few more bottles of the Shape Tape Foundation, Matte Formula while I can. It's the absolute BEST foundation I've ever used.
Thank you Tarte!! (Tarte also makes the very best concealer ever made...."Tarte Shape Tape Concealer", still available and in production).

title: Damaged or do it yourself? Is it cruelty free....
text:
Feathers can be a little controversial. Rest assured that these are cruelty free! I used to have a peacock as a pet. He shed those beautiful tail feathers every year, and even though he is long gone I still have some of his gorgeous plumes. Peacock feathers are not harvested from the animal, you simply pick them up as they are naturally shed.
This set arrived in a plastic bag. When I pulled the pieces out, there were three peacock feather pieces and one headband. Each feather piece has a rhinestone accent at the bottom. One is all rhinestone, one is a pearl surrounded by rhinestones, and one is a London blue stone surrounded by rhinestones.
Of the two larger pieces, one has an alligator clip hot glued onto the felt backing, and one has a strip of grossgrain ribbon glued to the back. Although I'm not sure, I suspect that it was at one time glued to the headband, or they leave it to the consumer to glue it to the headband. I tried to push the end of the headband through the middle of the ribbon, thinking that perhaps it could slide on, but it is glued completely, you can't slide it onto the headband.
The smaller piece also has an alligator type clip of the same size as the larger clipped piece. They stay beautifully in your hair and are actually comfortable.

I wouldn't call this a glamor or fashion accessory set, it's definitely a costume set that would be great for a roaring twenties party. Each one would also be a fun addition to a hat. I wear a lot of hats and love to adorn them with scarves and feathers.

The following is not part of my review but it is a kind of funny peacock story. naturally, when guests came over they wanted to see him with his tail spread out in beautiful peacock glory. They only open up like that when they're trying to impress someone, and he certainly was never impressed by any of my guests. At the time I also had a miniature pig. That peacock was so in love with the pig that whenever she came near him he would spread out his feathers and shake them hoping she would notice and return his love. Of course that never happened, the pig could care less. But whenever we wanted to show him off to our friends, we would walk the pig over to him and he would immediately open his tail feathers with a great flourish! My friends and I were all impressed. Maggie the pig was not.

title: Takes care of chapped skin...
text:
Back in the 1980s, I was working on a dairy farm in South Dakota where we had temps drop down below -40F and the wind chill would hit -110F. My sister and mother were always lathering on lotion and complaining about dry skin. My brother and I didn't have any problems, even though we were working outdoors and in the barns in extreme conditions and often had our hands wet. When this was brought up at church, the farm ladies laughed and said it was because we boys were applying udder balm to the cows post milking and then rubbing the remains into our hands. Since then, there has always been a tin of this stuff to be found in our homes.

I do wish it were a bit less greasy. However, if I rub it on my hands and ankles/shins after my morning shower during the dry times of the year, all is well for the rest of the day.

title: I am pleased to report that all of my wishes were granted ...
text:
I purchased this grooming product for my boyfriend, who boasts a luxurious and manly beard and mustache. My hope was that I could cajole him into curling the length of his mustache into a jaunty upturned handlebar style by promising a product that would be effective without being offensive. I am pleased to report that all of my wishes were granted in Wild Willie's Mustache Wax.

The aroma was pleasant and subtle, neither irritating he, who had to wear it beneath his nostrils, nor myself, who inhaled of it's gentle fragrance upon each occasion that I did place my lips to his in affectionate embrace. Indeed after a short period of time, he did declare he was barely able to detect it at all unless he expended some considerable amount of effort into the pursuit. I myself was unable to detect it unless I found myself pressed closely against his person - a position I repeatedly sought out strictly for the purposes of ensuring the quality and inoffensiveness of this product. (A sacrifice I made gladly and would willingly make again.)

In terms of performance, he found the wax to be a most excellent medium to control the curvature and shape of his whiskers. While the wax did warrant reapplying after some wear, and particularly the consumption of liquids, it did not impart flavor upon his beverages, nor did it spoil the taste of foods. It would be worth keeping the container on his person though, should any man wish to enjoy a full night out with his facial hair elegantly sculpted throughout. Indeed, it would be a shame to spend an evening with a sad and droopy mustache.

The pop out mustache trimmer is way too small and very hard to deploy. They could have left that out of the design and included a separate trimmer which would have been more useful. All in all I like this razor but I must admit that I'm not as excited about the purchase as I have been in the past with older models.

title: INSTRUCTION FOR THOSE WITH FINE HAIR
text:
I have a full head of fine hair that needs product in order to look good. Keep that in mind, since products have different results depending on your hair type and amount. After testing out this Atlas Putty several different ways I’ve found that it has some great benefits if you use it along with other products as well.
I would not call it “thickening”. It does add some body and a little shine. And the unexpected surprise is that it also brought out the wave in my hair (most clays and other products I use tend to make my hair straighter).. It has what I would call a “soft hold” - easy to run my hands through band a feeling that there really isn’t any product in it at all. Yet it does keep my hair from being flat, which is its natural state without product.
The magic formula I have settled on is: After showering and shampooing, start with a thickening spray of some sort, like a sea salt spray with some added hold (some have it and some don’t). Once you’ve dried your hair then either go straight to the Atlas Putty, or use a little clay first and then go to the Atlas Putty. And go light with the Atlas. You can always add a little more, because it is quite soft out of the tin, and works into the hair quite easily. Sounds like a lot, but it takes me five to ten minutes to dry and style with all of these steps. And the results are really worth it. Whereas normally my hair is pretty limp, using these steps results in tons of compliments. Oh and yes, the smell is nice. An added plus.
I don’t think this will be a product I use every day, but it will definitely be in my rotation (OK - I’m a bit of a product hoarder). Worth the money and a great product overall.

title: Pretty Simple To Use, Stings A Little, No Issues So Far, Awaiting Potential Results
text:
So far, I have no real complaints about this NIRA Skincare Laser & Hyaluronic Acid Serum Bundle. I’m still at the point where I’m not sure if I can say it truly works because I need to use it for a longer period of time, but I’ll discuss various aspects about the product that will hopefully help with your decision-making.

-Came well-packaged in a small, but sturdy cardboard box. Everything arrived intact. I have continued to use this box for storage of the product.
-Comes with the handheld laser device, charger with base to plug into an outlet, and manual
-No complaints about the battery life so far
-Simple to use: there are two buttons: The power button that turns the device on. Then you can press it to cycle through the various levels of intensity 1-5 which are clearly shown using green light bars. You can then hold the power button down to turn the device off again. The top button can be pressed to activate the laser after you have chosen the level of intensity you want.
-The laser only works if positioned correctly over an area of skin. It will give a single negative sounding beep if not positioned correctly, and a positive sounding double beep if it is positioned correctly as the laser works. You wait to move the device to the next area after you hear that second beep indicating that it is finished with that laser sequence
-The device has a white, plastic outer shell. It is lightweight while still feeling sturdy and durable. I would still be very careful not to drop this as I’m not sure how it could handle a fall
-I would recommend experimenting on the lower intensity settings. The undereye area is pretty sensitive. I feel I have a pretty high pain tolerance, but my eyes often still tear up after using per instructions on the highest settings of 4 and 5. For whatever reason, my left eye is much more sensitive to this.
-I don’t want to say it is truly painful, but I suppose the best way to describe the sensation is almost similar to if you were being stung by a rubber band that you pulled back and let hit your skin if that makes sense. It isn’t comfortable, but you do get more used to this and can work your way up to a higher level of intensity. You will probably also feel some warmth on the skin after using.
-I know this is marketed for under the eyes, but I have also been using on my forehead and by my smile lines.

***The instruction manual is pretty clear and straightforward. You definitely need to read this before getting started. Here is some information that you can find within the manual:

-They say all skin tones and anyone over the age of 12 can use NIRA to reduce the appearance of wrinkles around the eyes
-You need to clean and dry your face just prior to using NIRA
-It can be using morning or night and up to twice daily. They recommend waiting 1 minute before retreating each area and not to treat more than twice within a 1-hour period.
-Do not treat the same spot twice in a row, even if the pulse is rejected and you get the low pitched, negative sounding beep
-The instructions clearly show you the recommended way to treat the undereye area and the treatment pattern to use
-They recommend using the highest power level where you feel warmth without pain
-You should use a facial moisturizer after each treatment and a daily sunscreen with at least SPF 30 is recommended. This bundle includes the hyaluronic acid serum which can also be used.
-Device should be kept clean and free of dust, especially the glass lens which can be cleaned with a cotton swab. Surfaces can be cleaned with 70% alcohol solution between each use.
-They say some potential side effects include: skin warmth, redness, and stinging. Less frequent side effects include dryness, roughness, tanned appearance to skin, swelling, flaking, itching, crusting, bruising, pimple-like rash, irritated skin, blistering, scarring, infection, and skin color changes where your skin may become darker or lighter. I have only experienced the temporary warmth and stinging during use- no redness or anything else.
-The company also cautions those who have skin conditions or are undergoing professional cosmetic treatments such as injectable toxins like Botox or fillers- saying to check with your doctor or clinician prior to using NIRA.
-Only use on intact skin
-Don’t use if pregnant or nursing or undergoing fertility treatments
-Do not use if you have a history of skin cancer, any other cancer, or pre-malignant moles
-Do not treat if you have tanned skin which is apparently at increased risk of adverse effects with light-based devices

Overall, I’m happy with how the product functions and the ease of use. I will continue using and will update if I have any further comments or concerns. I haven’t noticed any real results yet, but I also haven’t been using it that long. One question that comes to mind is this: What is the lifespan of this device? Months? Years? Or does it give out after firing the laser a certain number of times? I could have missed it in the manual, but that is something I’m still not sure of. For the current price of $329, that is something I think people may want to know. I haven’t had any issues with the serum that comes in this package, but it seems pretty simple and basic.

title: They changed the formula since 2020
text:
The original 2020 formula had great slip, hydrated my kinky hair, while creating AMAZING curls. I could wear the product for two weeks without shampooing, but refreshing the curls and adding more product every other day. It air-dried easily too.

The 2021 version has a different formula with different ingredients. If you have kinky hair it won’t create curls, it doesn’t have good slip anymore and it definitely does not dry easily. HOWEVER, if you’re looking for something to nurture and moisturize your strands, this is the product to use. It’s best used on damp, clean, conditioned hair; you can then add in this product and put your hair into small twists.

Yes, it takes FOREVER (DAYSS) to dry because the main ingredient is marshmallow root which is a very sticky substance when melted BUT once it is dry, you can untwist and the hair is shiny, soft, and swishes side to side on its own.

If you prefer untwisted styles, I suggest putting in the product all over your clean, damp hair, wait a day for it to dry, then add in the gel of your choice while gently detangling.

Either way I notice that while using it I retain more length, experience less breakage, and more scalp health.

Moral of the story: because of the formula changing over the past few years, this product takes a lot work if your texture is more kinky/coily. Biggest suggestion: use if you’re google to use it, commit to it and learn how to make it work. If you’re looking for a quick fix, I don’t recommend this product for you.

Science. 🤷🏽‍♀️

Overall, I guess you get what you pay for. In this case, I spent $7 and in turn received a cheap, poor quality product. text:
This device is very similar to wax warming devices. It matches some higher end wax warmers, with the variable temperature control (some low cost wax warmers have an on/off switch only). The aluminum warming pot seems to have thinner wall thickness, though. The warming/melting pot is very light weight.
Wax warmers, with variable temperature controls, range in price $20 - $60 (with some on sale for under $20, and some 'professional' level units considerably more expensive). So, at $50, this is close to the upper end of the price range.
This warmer does heat up and maintains the chosen temperature. We tested the warming device with massage oil, and it does a credible job. A nice touch is a red light indicates the device is in the heating process to attain the selected temperature. It turns green, when it's at the selected temperature, giving a 'green light' to use the warmed material.
Overall, it's a competent warming device that seems a bit pricey. It does meet expectations, earning a 3.75 - 4 star rating.

title: Great metallic nail polishes
text:
I just got these and had to test out most of the colors right away. This was my first time using any Kleancolor polishes so I had no idea what to expect. I was very pleasantly surprised on the quality. For polishes that came to less than $1 each, they cover very well with just one coat. Usually with polishes that inexpensive they are very thin/sheer and don't cover well, which is not the case at all with these.

I knew that not all the colors were going to be to my taste/ones I would actually use (just a preference thing) but I'm happy with the majority of them. Some were better than I had hoped they would be once I tried them out. (They look better on your nails than in the bottle.)

The white metallic doesn't seem very metallic to me and that was the only one that seemed too thick like it was an old bottle. It might be better going over another color than by itself, or maybe that one bottle was just a bit of a dud. And the black seems fairly flat with very little hint of metallic. The rest are very shiny and metallic, which is just what I was going for. I was really into the Sally Hansen chrome line from years back and still have the ones I bought - but since it's been a long time since I bought those most of them are getting too old/thick. Fortunately, some of these colors seem very close to the ones I had bought back in the day. There is a little bit more of a glitter undertone to most of these compared to the other chrome polishes, but it's not overwhelmingly glittery.

I will say that these polishes have a stronger smell than most polishes I've used but it dissipates pretty quickly.

They also seem to dry pretty quickly as well.

Overall, I'd highly recommend this set to anyone who likes metallic nail polishes. The variety of colors is great and the quality is much better than you'd expect for how much they cost. I can't say yet with regard to how long they can go without chipping. I honestly don't expect it to be long for my fingernails but that's just the case with ALL polishes I find. If they chip within a day or two, then that's just par for the course for fingers. Though I'm too lazy to ever do a topcoat, so maybe it would last longer with a well applied topcoat. I do expect they'd last a good while on toes though since that just seems to be the nature of the beast.

text:
USE THIS ON CURLY HAIR for smooth curls!!!!! I know this seems strange. But I bought this product because I received a REALLY bad perm at a salon and after dealing with damage, fuzz and frizz for about 4 months I was fed up and decided to give up and straighten it. The prices for a salon straitening treatment was outrageous. So I decided to attempt it myself.

When the box arrived, I loved how all of the products are full sized. I was going to wait until the weekend to do the whole straightening process but decided to go ahead and try out the clarifying shampoo and deep conditioners during the week. I could tell even after the first use of the shampoo and conditioner what a difference it made to the texture of my hair. It softened it and smoothed the curls and now I can run my fingers through it without it tangling.

So needless to say, the shampoo and conditioners alone fixed my fuzzy issues without having to straighten my hair. I love my soft curls now and am so grateful that I decided to "test" the shampoos and conditioners. It just made sense to me to try it because even though these are made to smooth straight hair, it can still smooth curls as well. So I use #1,3,4,5 every week. I went ahead and tossed #2 - the straightening solution.

They need to market their conditioners and shampoos to curly headed people!! Unfortunately I will have to buy the whole kit each time I need to replace the conditioner or shampoo since they do not sell the separate :-( But, this product has saved my hair so it is totally worth it.

title: Fantastic product for oily skin.
text:
This product isn't sold in the US unfortunately, so it may take a little bit longer to ship. That said, it's definitely worth the wait. I have extremely oily skin, and this does a very good job at lessening it. When I don't use this, I have to use multiple oil-blotting sheets throughout the day. My usual routine is to use a cleanser that helps with the oil - something with salicylic acid, or lately Dermologica's Dermal Clay Cleanser, then use some witch hazel as an astringent/toner. After that I use a little bit of oil-free moisturizer, then once that's try, I put this under base on. I noticed immediately that it dries very fast. It doesn't make your skin dry, but I don't have to wait forever for it to soak in before I put on my makeup - it helps the moisturizer soak in faster too. My pores looked much smaller, and my skin felt very smooth. Like other reviewers have said, it made a very nice canvas for the makeup.
You may find yourself surprised at the size when you receive it - the canister is much smaller than you might expect, and it's metal. Depending on how much you use, you might want to go ahead and buy two, just because of how long it will take you to receive your next one. Just put this in my hair and I am more than pleased with my results, though, I in general give less of a F**** than others might when it comes to hair things, hence the four-star review. Also, since I have yet to see if it fades into something awful, I will leave it at four until proven better.

My story is rather boring, but I will share it for all those who are either SUPER bored or indecisive. I have a honey blonde hair color, which is pretty thick but manageable. Basically, if you are a hair stylist, my hair is dream.

Tdoday when I was wondering how best to let the world know that I was a bad a**, when I decided, f-ya, gonna dye my hair pink. Wanting to do it at 10:30 pm, and not wanting to spend a bajillion dollars, I got this (not from Amazon but from a 24 hour pharmacy).

After reading reviews about dying clothes and skin, I was uber cautious, and only dyed one streak. I left it on for 15 minutes or so, washed it out, put conditioner, and voila, insta-rebellious color awesomeness. It is MUCH darker than the color because I didn't bleach it first even though it was in the directions. I decided this for three reasons: first, I wanted to rebel against the rebellious hair color; second, I wanted it now and not to have to wait an additional however long; and third, there were a bunch of extra steps on the directions. So I picked out my bit o-hair, and pulled it through my cap (which I had to do with a bobby pin), and 15 minutes later I had a lovely, magenta streak.

text:
I'm just getting back into using a safety razor after decades of using a multiblade cartridge razor and/or really high end electric shavers, and I'm very happy with this kit. Functionality wise, is just excellent. It's easy to switch out blades, nice weight to it, nice grip. I also really like the brush and stand and the look of the whole set displayed in my bathroom. It's great when a razor works well, but it's even better when it looks great for the 23.5 hours per day that you're not using it.

The blades that come with the set seem decent, but I also ordered a 15 brand 2-blade variety pack, and will be going through each of these brands to find the one(s) I like the most.

If you're just getting back into safety razor shaving like me or if you're doing this for the first time, hang in there. Watching a few YouTube videos will help you. Most importantly, do not treat this like a multi-blade, lubricated cartridge razor. Safety razors are one-pass razors, do not apply pressure, and don't shy away from pre/after shaving skin/beard conditioners, lotions, etc. When you do everything right, this single blade will give you the best, closest shave you've ever had.

title: Myconos Long Lasting Multi BB Cushion 💧
text:
This is my first BB Cushion Compact.
I've had great experiences with Myconos products n the past so decided to try this out to for that full - Bang effect.

I currently own the following Myconos brand products:
- Gel cleanser
- Whitening & Brightening Essence/ Serum
- Night Repair Whitening Cream
- Deep Sea Whitening Mask
- (This) Myconos Magic BB Moist Air Cushion Compact.

* I will also add, I use these in conjunction/ in order :)

My Skin Type:
I have oily skin with acne spots occassionally.
My skin doesn't react well to extra moisturizing products like most bb cream for instance, they make me break out.

But, I decided to purchase this because I've read from other reviewers with oily skin that it didn't cause a hindrance for them- using this.
Sooo glad I did!

My First Impression/ Thoughts/ and Views:

- The design is pretty, unique & the holographic logo is quite attractive.
- Smells very fancy. Almost reminds me of Chanel.
- This goes smoothly.
- It is build able for me without looking too "cakey"
- Did not clog my pores. I was rest assured whenever I wore this, there wouldn't be a giant pimple at the end of the day on my forehead.
- The way the cushion is placed inside the compact is very sanitary, since there are layers to open to get to the bb cushion cream inside.
- Apparently this has "whitening properties" too
- I am in love with the fact this has a whopping 50spf! (Sun damage prevention is important to me)
- Anti-aging properties (Not too strong though I'm sure since other anti-aging products I've tried has broken me out before. I'm 22.)
- One of the best part of this product in my opinion is how you get an extra "refill of BB/CC foundation" Not even some other popular brands or Sephora items do that. So you're getting a considerable amount for the price.

Cons:

Aside from all the benefits, the only issue I've come across is sometimes (since I have oily skin) within a few hours,
if I don't pat down with a powder of some sort then my face gets sticky.
This is certainly an ideal product for those with "dry skin" type.

Conclusion:

In the end, the pros and benefits I got from using this bb cushion pact, definitely overcomes the negatives.
I love this bb cushion pact and will continue to keep using it. '

Since this is my first time using one and it's working so great, it'll possibly be my last time since there's another refill so this will last me a long time in a long run.

title: Mitchell's Wool Fat Shaving Soap
text:
I have been using this soap for the last few months and I love it. This soap produces a rich lather and I never need to reload my brush for subsequent passes. This soap takes a lot of water to thin out (which seems to be a common characteristic of good shave soaps). The soap has a soapy scent which some people like or don't like, but it smells good to me. It doesn't seem too strong of a scent to me either, but some people think it does based off of what I have read about it before I bought it. Even if you think the scent is strong, it doesn't seem to linger like Tobac does, but provides as good of a lather.

Perhaps the greatest characteristic of this soap (at least boasted by the brand) is that it is made using wool fat, which has lanolin. Lanolin is a wax secreted by sheep (and I guess other "woolly" animals) that helps protect the animals skin and wool from the environment and is often added to soaps (among other things) as a moisturizer. That being said, I don't really notice any huge difference in moisturizing, but I don't have really dry skin either. So, who knows? I can't tell you whether or not it will help you with dryness, but it works well for me and may work well for you too.

If you have dry or sensitive skin, I would recommend looking for a review written by someone who also has dry or sensitive skin. Even though the company boasts the qualities of lanolin, there are other ingredients that may be a problem for you (maybe even the lanolin itself).

title: Works Quite Well, Love It!
text: My eyebrows, eyeliner, and lip color are permanent makeup. Not going to lie. However, there are times when even someone with permanent makeup needs a touch up, and eyebrows seem to require a touch up more than anything else. I love this tattoo pen for touch ups. The strokes applied really do look exactly like eyebrow hairs, and I found them easy to apply. The pen is like a felt-tip pen, so if you can use one of those, you can use this. Sometimes it seems as though the color doesn't want to come out. If that happens, just hold the pen with the applicator side down, and it will work fine. For me, at least, the product has been smudge-proof and lasts till I wash it off. (It is waterproof; you have to apply cleanser to remove it.) The color looks quite natural as well and blends with my real eyebrows and permanent makeup perfectly. This isn't just for people with permanent makeup, however. This is a wonderful tattoo pen for those with natural eyebrows who just want to fill them in a bit, make them fuller and more lush. (Haven't we all over-plucked or over-waxed?) Heavy eyebrows seem to be "in" right now, and if that's what you want, this tattoo pen will give them to you. The only minus I can find right now is that my color is not in stock. Highly recommended.

text:
These pins are a mixed bag. The double-tined pins are the best. Those pins are long and strong, with a touch of flexibility. One of these keeps my hair up and out of the way without snagging or pulling.

The single pins, are also strong and flexible...just not very long. If you've got lots of thick curly hair as I do, it will take several strategically placed pins to keep things together.

Finally some of the single pins have a raised design that runs the full length of the too-short pin. The problem is that the raised design catches at my hair and pulls. You might get the pin in, and enough of them to hold your hair up, but it may come loose, carrying part of your hair with it, making it harder to reinsert. Intentionally pulling these pins out is just as bad.

So if you are fine paying the total price for the double-tined pins in the collection, it's all good. If not, and your hair is fine with the shorter smooth pins, it's still good.

I do not recommend using the pins with the full length design. Ouch.

title: Meh...
text:
I like false nails, but I don’t like really long ones. When I saw these looked short, I thought they’d be great! I wasn’t too sure about the diamond gemstones on them. I was a little worried they would look too gaudy, for my taste at least. But, the images of the nails on the hands in the product photos they didn’t look too bad, the ones on the thumbs seemed a little big but I figured that was okay.

So, I get them and see the diamond gemstones seem way bigger than they do in the product photos. But, I figure they’re worth a try anyways!

It took me FOREVER to sort them into their separate sizes. Of course, when I was laying them out to take the photos of them, I noticed that the plastic part you pull off the nail to reveal the adhesive have numbers on them 🤦‍♀️ Wish I would have seen them when I went to apply them! The instructions say NOTHING about them having numbered labels. And, the numbers are REALLY hard to see. So if you don’t have perfect eyesight, you might have a really hard time! I have perfect eyesight and still had trouble. I showed in a photo the best I could the number on one of the nails. That one is labeled 2. In the photo I have with them all separated and labeled, so maybe it will help someone avoid the headache of figuring it out!

The nails themselves I feel are kind of small and the thumbs I think are too big. Like my fingers aren’t too big. The 0 ones were too big for my thumbs. I had to go with the 1 ones. But then the 2 were too small for my middle finger. The 1 ones fit good, but there was only 3 of them and I was already going to use 2 of them for my thumbs. So I had to use the 0 ones for my thumbs which were too big, so they looked weird. I feel like only having 3 of each size isn’t enough. I wore these before taking the photo showing them all separated. I kept the ones I had worn and taken off to include them in their size group. Having only 3 of each size, if one size fits 2 different fingers, you’d need 4 so you wouldn’t have enough, which is an issue I had.

I don’t like that there’s only 2 sizes with nothing on them, both tiny, pinkie kind of size nails. Usually when I wear something - gems, designs, etc. on my nails, I either have the designs on my ring and pointer finger, just my ring finger, maybe my thumb as well. But not every finger. But with these you pretty much have to, except for your pinkie. The 2 sizes that have the other design on them (the 5 and 55 ones), those sizes are so darn close that it’s almost impossible to tell the difference. So it doesn’t give much choice to have those on different fingers either. I ended up putting them on my pointer finger. So every finger had a diamond gemstone except for the pointer fingers that had the other design and the pinkies that had nothing.

I like that the set comes with the stick for your cuticles, the nail file, and a alcohol swab. The nail file is great. The nails stick well. I used the cuticle stick to push back my cuticles, filed my nails, and then used the alcohol swab on them. Then I attached the nails. I used them as stick on ones, with the adhesive only. If you wanted them to last longer, you could use glue as well. I just wanted to test them out how they were so I only used the adhesive that’s on each nail. They stuck very well. The only issue I had was the size 1 ones that I used for my middle finger didn’t curve over my middle finger well, so the corner looked like it was sort of lifted. But it still stayed stuck on well and didn’t pop off throughout the 2 days I had them on, doing all the normal things I do every day. They probably would have lasted much longer, but I didn’t want them on anymore. I didn’t like how big the diamond gemstones were. I didn’t like they had the diamond gemstones on so many nails. As I said, I would have preferred only having them on the ring finger, maybe pointer finger, possibly thumb. But not all. I didn’t like the ones on my thumbs (the 0’s) looked so big since I had to use those on my thumbs instead of the 1’s since I had to use those on my middle fingers.

Overall, for $15.20 (at the time of writing this review), I don’t think they’re worth it at all. If you feel your fingers are the right size to have better options when choosing sizes, if you like bigger gemstones, if you like gemstones on pretty much every nail, then you would probably really enjoy these. Like I said, they apply well and stick well. But, if you’re like me and don’t like big gemstones on your nails and don’t like gemstones on pretty much every nail, then these probably aren’t for you. Honestly, I can get a set that has more size options and designs I really like at the drugstore for way less. So these just aren’t for me!
